embed.title: Welcome to {server}!
embed.description:
Hey {user_mention}, we're excited to have you here!

You are our **{member_ordinal}** member. 🎉

Please read the rules and grab your roles below to get full access.

fields.name: 📜 Rules (Main)
fields.value:
Start by reading our primary rules in {channel:rules_main}.
These cover server-wide behavior, Discord ToS compliance, and general expectations.

fields.name: 📜 Rules (NSFW)
fields.value: Then check {channel:rules_nsfw} for extra rules, NSFW-specific guidelines, and channel-specific requirements.

fields.name: 🍵 Roles – General & Pings
fields.value:
Head over to {channel:roles_general} to:
> • Pick **general roles** (age, region, pronouns, etc.)
> • Opt in/out of **ping roles** for announcements and events.

fields.name: 🍋 Roles – NSFW Roles
fields.value:
Visit {channel:roles_nsfw} to:
> • Choose **NSFW roles** so others see what you are interested in
> • Select **preferred NSFW roles** (Maledom, Femdom, etc.) to unlock NSFW channels and content.

fields.name: 🛡️ Roles – Kinks
fields.value:
Finally, go to {channel:roles_kinks} to:
> • Select **kink roles** to communicate your interests and preferences
> • These roles are optional but help others understand your boundaries and desires.

fields.name: 📌 Quick Tips
fields.value:
- Be respectful and follow all rules at all times.
- Need help? Make a ticket in {channel:tickets}.
- Use the proper channels for NSFW, Images, and off-topic chat.

fields.name: 💬 Community Engagement
fields.value: We encourage you to participate in discussions, events, and activities. Your presence makes our community stronger!
